shortDescription: Stacks up to 7 playable z-levels (3 up / 3 down) into ONE banded RimWorld Map joined by synthetic RegionLink wormholes, so hauling, needs, work and storage come free from vanilla. Four vanilla-matched per-level sizes (126/190/250/300) and level counts are bought from a fixed 192,000-cell budget. Per-colony climate bands make high levels genuinely alpine. Mountain mass renders through every level down to the first solid floor, which is what makes a deep column read as depth.

> **NOTE TO SELF:** running spec, not a changelog. §0 handover; §1-19 architecture; §20 compat; §21-29 bug records; §30 utility networks (IN PROGRESS). Keep every ⚠ - each cost a run to learn. # As above, So below II (V2) > V1 is DELETED. ~73 files, ~21,300 LOC. No em-dashes anywhere in shipped text. # 0. START HERE (handover, mid utility-network session) **What this mod is.** Up to seven z-levels in ONE RimWorld `Map`, banded along +z. Priorities in order: (1) visual clarity from above, (2) performance, (3) vanilla parity. **Where the work is NOW.** §30: cross-level UTILITY NETWORKS. **§30a is BUILT and compiles; everything else in §30 is designed only.** The renderer is CLOSED - the user called visuality done. §30 ships WITHOUT below-view pipe overlays (user's call). **The single most important open risk (unchanged).** §29's depth cut ships ON having been judged only by eye. **If any performance report arrives on a mountainous map, throw `MassDepthCutEnabled` first.** **How to test anything here.** `run_test_cycle`, then read the profile's TILE line BEFORE looking at pixels. For §30 you need the relevant host mod ACTIVE - use `companionMods`. **⚠ AND YOU MUST TEST §30a AT 190 OR 126, NEVER 300** - see §30a. --- ## Status Visuality, QOL, altitude/weather, settings VERIFIED. **250 tier VERIFIED (#236); 190x5 VERIFIED (#237-#240).** **✅ §24b ✅ §24c ✅ §27 ✅ §28 ✅ §29 accepted on look (#260).** **🔧 §25 FIXED, UNVERIFIED** (fog-on-reload + doubled/inverted stairs). **Biggest untested thing in the mod; needs the reporter's save.** **🔧 §30a BUILT, UNVERIFIED IN PLAY** (power gutter leak - `ABPowerBandScope.cs`, guard `ABGuard.Utilities`). **🚧 §30b-e DESIGNED, NOT BUILT.** Gates resolved, texture workbench shipped, no defs written yet. UNVERIFIED: §25, §29 cost, §30a, depth shrink, camera anchor, §18 audit, reroll grid, VEE compat, GL roof fix. **PUBLISHED-BUILD BUGS.** 1-11 all FIXED (§21-29). **12. Vanilla power leaks across the gutter - FIXED, UNVERIFIED (§30a).** --- # 1. ARCHITECTURE One `Map`, size `(w, 1, bandCount * Slot)`. Bands stack along +z from the deepest basement, gutter between. `Slot = ceil((bandHeight + MinGutter)/64)*64`; **64-alignment of SLOT is load-bearing**. **The one insight.** `Region.Neighbors` is *topological, not spatial*. Wormhole `RegionLink`s between one-cell `RegionType.Portal` ends conduct connectivity without merging rooms, temperature or vacuum. But reachability is not a path: 1.6's pathfinder is jobified and cannot traverse a synthetic link, hence segmented movement (§3). **⚠ THE TOPOLOGICAL TRICK DOES NOT GENERALISE TO UTILITY NETWORKS** (§30). `RegionLink` is read by the region graph and NOTHING else. Every power/pipe system on the machine builds its graph from raw CELL ADJACENCY (`GenAdj.CellsAdjacentCardinal`, `map.floodFiller.FloodFill`, `GenAdjFast.AdjacentCellsCardinal`) and never consults regions. Bands are 128-320 cells apart, so no arithmetic fix exists - the edges must be ADDED to each system's own graph builder. **⚠ THE GUTTER IS UNBUILDABLE BY CONSTRUCTION, AND THAT IS LOAD-BEARING FOR ALL OF §30.** `CarveGutters` writes `AB_OpenAir`, whose TerrainDef declares **no affordances at all**, while every building inherits `terrainAffordanceNeeded` Light from `BuildingBase`. So no conduit, pipe or duct can ever be laid in a seam. Combined with the fact that every net builder steps ONE cardinal cell, this proves that **no cell-adjacency net can cross a band unaided** - which is why §30 needs risers, and equally why the only vanilla power defect was the RADIUS search and not the flood fill (§30a). **Check this invariant before assuming a foreign net "might" bridge the gutter; it cannot.** **Hard 1.6 constraints.** Path grid is IJobParallelFor over EVERY cell. No `PathFinder.FindPath`. `BlocksDiagonalMovement` trips on unwalkable cells. **⚠ The stack is 2x to 7x anisotropic.** Anything vanilla normalises by BOTH dimensions is distorted. ### ⚠ THE SLICING RULE, eight shapes | Shape | Example | Fix | |---|---|---| | Anchor, a fraction of `Size.z` | river/lake centre; VEE Crater jitter | remap the point | | Field, a gradient on map centre | coastline (§6e); VEE LoneIsland and Crater | re-centre the sample coordinate | | Noise space, a slice is not a short map | Map Preview (§6d); GL landform grids (§22); **Rimefeller oil (§30e)** | generate at full height, then crop | | Distance-to-extent, a margin off `Size` | `CloseToEdge`, no-build edge; river WIDTH | re-base onto the cell's band rect | | **Aspect ratio, normalised by BOTH dims** | preview window and reroll grid (§6d) | lay out from the BAND, generate at the STACK | | **Map-wide scalar** | snow melt (§7), temperature readout (§16), GL roof sweep | rewrite it per cell at the consumer | | **Foreign absolute writes** (§22) | GL landform output lands in band 0 | ORDER, not arithmetic | | **Radius search wider than the gutter** (§30a) | `PowerConnectionMaker` ConnectMaxDist 6 vs a 2-row gutter | clip the search rect to the cell's band | Still unaudited: Basin, Cavern, Chasm, Cliffs, Hollow, Valley (all `FalloffAtAngle`). **`ABBandLocal.cs` is THE canonical FIELD rewrite** plus `BandLocalModule`, a `ModuleBase` wrapper for direct noise samplers. # 2. LEVEL PLAN, budget 192,000 cells **⚠ THE 64 CONSTRAINT IS ON *SLOT*, NOT BAND HEIGHT.** | size | slot | gutter | cells/band | playable | max levels | total | |---|---|---|---|---|---|---| | 126 | 128 | 2 | 16,128 | 98.4% | 7 (cap) | 112,896 | | 190 | 192 | 2 | 36,480 | 99.0% | 5 | 182,400 ✅ | | **250** | 256 | 6 | 64,000 | 97.7% | 3 | **192,000** ✅ | | **300** | 320 | 20 | 96,000 | 93.8% | 2 | **192,000** | 250/300 are vanilla's Medium and Large exactly. Ladder 7/5/3/2. **⚠ 200 IS THE ONE NUMBER TO AVOID.** **Waste is a SAWTOOTH.** **⚠ A WIDE GUTTER IS A FEATURE** - "a spatial helper that reaches 22 rows will cross a 2-row gutter" is the root of §15a, §4 **and §30a**. **⚠ AND THE GUTTER WIDTH VARIES BY TIER, SO A GUTTER-CROSSING BUG IS TIER-DEPENDENT** (§30a): band-to-band gap is 3 at 126/190, 7 at 250, 21 at 300. A leak with reach 6 is INVISIBLE on the two largest tiers and present on the two most-played ones. **Test gutter bugs on 190 or 126; a clean run at 300 proves nothing.** **⚠ THE PLAN PERSISTS BETWEEN COLONIES AND SILENTLY CONSTRAINS THE SIZE.** **⚠ Own the widget, do not patch the data.** # 3-5. MOVEMENT, ORDERING, DESCENT **Cross-band movement** segmented at ONE interception; hops must strictly decrease. **Multi-hop UNTESTED IN PLAY.** **Group ordering:** the drag line runs through the GUTTER; odd/even signature is the proof. **⚠ ONE DESCENT RULE: `TryResolveVisibleBelow`.** TEN systems share it. **NINE appearances of the single-step bug.** **`TryResolveVisibleFrom` is THE gate.** **⚠ AND THE GATE ANSWERS TWO QUESTIONS, NOT ONE** (§27). **⚠ §29 ADDS A SECOND, RENDERING-ONLY DESCENT BESIDE IT - NOT A WIDENING OF IT.** # 6. SKY-MASS PRESENTATION Despeckle, central fog hole, five-terrain plateau palette, cliff faces, alpine pass. **⚠ The mass tapers with altitude, so +3 may contain NO LAND AT ALL.** (#237): surface 12,723 plants; +3 **37**. **⚠ THE SKY BAND'S OWN MASS IS `AB_MountainTop` TERRAIN AND NOTHING ELSE IDENTIFIES IT.** **Snow-holding decides where snow fades.** # 6a. ⚠ THE BELOW VIEW IS MIRRORED PASSES, NOT ONE RENDERER `SectionLayer_ABBelowV2` ports vanilla `SectionLayer_Terrain` **and nothing else**. Confirmed five times. **⚠ THE CONVERSE IS HANDLED** - `FinishNewVerts` transforms by VERTEX RANGE. Preserve that. **⚠ THREE DIFFERENT THINGS ARE ALL CALLED "MASS"** (undug edifice / sky terrain / mined leave-terrain). **⚠ AND THE MASS FILL IS EMITTED FROM THREE PLACES** (§28). **⚠ THE CAP IS SINGLE-STEP.** **⚠ VISIBILITY IS DECIDED ENTIRELY BY `ABBands.ShowsBelow(terrain)`.** **⚠ A SMOOTHING KERNEL IS A SECOND CONSUMER OF THAT SAME RULE** (§27). **⚠ AND A `dontRender` VIEWING CELL MEANS OUR FILL IS THE ONLY BACKDROP** (§28b). **⚠ EVERY FOREIGN NETWORK SHIPS ITS OWN `SectionLayer`, AND NONE OF THEM ARE MIRRORED** (§30f). DBH six, Rimatomics five, Rimefeller three, VEF one. No shared funnel, which is why §30 ships without it. # 6b-6g. WATER, PREVIEW, COASTS, SNOW, SHRINK **Water** is TWO-PASS SCREEN-SPACE. **⚠ ALL THREE INERT UNDER GL** (§22). **⚠ 6d-CLAMP:** `Clamp()` returns the largest size ≤ input; Map Preview passes VANILLA's size. **Fix: `PlannedSize`.** **⚠ MAP PREVIEW SHIPS IN TWO HALVES AND GL BUNDLES ONE.** **Do not "simplify" `Active`.** **Coasts:** CENTRED wrong, not scaled wrong. **6f. Below-snow:** geometry built ONCE - **never `ClearSubMeshes(All)` here**. **Depth shrink (UNVERIFIED):** **⚠ the atlas trap**; **⚠ natural rock excluded BY DEF, not by link type**. **⚠ PERSPECTIVE MODE WAS BUILT AND REMOVED. Do not re-add as polish.** # 7-8a. CHARACTER, CAMERA Ore `x(1+0.45*(depth-1))` through our OWN `ABOreGen.ScatterOres`. **⚠ The snow line never worked.** **The camera clamp and level-switch input share `ABGuard.Camera`.** **New-game anchor:** only `StartedNewGame` runs after vanilla's own camera jump. # 9. Has voided or explained EIGHT comparisons. **⚠ THE WATER REPORT DOES NOT AND SHOULD.** ## 9b. ⚠ "COST IS DESTRUCTION NOT GENERATION" - NO LONGER TRUE. Scattered ruins. 5. Perlin precompute. # 10-12. PERF AND DIAGNOSTICS 59.6 fps at 96 pawns. **⚠ THAT BENCHMARK MEASURES THE WRONG THING** - cost is in section-regeneration BURSTS. **⚠ Bisect toggles PERSIST across runs.** STAMPED INTO THE PROFILE. **⚠ The pre-pinned palette always strips its LAST entry. n=13.** Keep padding with a DISTINCT throwaway. **⚠ THE AUTO-PROMPT IS EDGE-TRIGGERED, SO CHECK THE COUNT, NOT THE TEXT.** **⚠ OUR OWN PROFILE AND BISECT LINES ARRIVE AS `warning` ROWS ATTRIBUTED TO US.** **⚠ Debug actions are `AllowedGameStates.PlayingOnMap`.** **⚠ AUDIT A DIAGNOSTIC'S OWN FILTERS BEFORE TRUSTING A NEGATIVE.** **⚠ A GUARD SWITCH WITH NO CALL SITE IS NOISE, NOT SAFETY.** Twelve dead V1 switches (including `power` and `pipes`) were deleted because `AllSwitches` feeds the settings status readout. **Add a switch in the same commit as its guard** - `Utilities` was added with §30a, not ahead of it. # 13. LESSONS **Method.** Prove a subsystem innocent by finding a state where the suspect CANNOT EXIST. Change one thing per experiment. Run the diagnostic before the third theory. A beautiful fit is not evidence. **⚠ ASSERTING AN INVARIANT IS NOT ESTABLISHING IT.** Carry the ANSWER, not the assumption. **⚠ HALF-IMPOSED ORDERING IS WORSE THAN NONE.** When you take over an ordering, take over ALL of it. **⚠ FIXING A HOLE BY LOOKING SIDEWAYS WHEN THE ANSWER WAS DOWNWARD.** **⚠ COUNT THE EMITTERS BEFORE FIXING THE LOOK.** **⚠ CLEAR THE OTHER SUSPECT BY READING ITS DATA, NOT ITS CODE.** **⚠ A FIX FOR MOD X CAN BE A REGRESSION FOR EVERYONE WITHOUT X.** **⚠ REPRODUCING A SUBSYSTEM MEANS REPRODUCING ALL OF IT.** **⚠ A COMMENT THAT JUSTIFIES SKIPPING ONE CHECK CAN BE HIDING A SECOND CHECK IT NEVER MENTIONS.** **⚠ REUSING A PREDICATE IS REUSING ITS HIDDEN CONDITIONS.** **⚠ AN EVENT HOOK THAT LOOKS INCREMENTAL MAY BE A FULL-MAP SWEEP ON THE LOAD PATH.** **⚠ TWO RESOLVERS FOR ONE QUANTITY IS A BUG WITH A DELAY FUSE.** **⚠ READ THE GUARD CLAUSES OF THE HELPER YOU ARE ABOUT TO REUSE - INCLUDING YOUR OWN.** **⚠ ASK HOW THE SUBSYSTEM REPRESENTS THE THING, NOT WHAT THE THING IS.** **⚠ THE USER'S REPHRASING IS DATA.** **⚠ A DIRECTIONAL WORD IN A REPORT IS A GRADIENT.** **⚠ TWO SYMPTOMS REPORTED IN ONE BREATH ARE PROBABLY ONE BUG.** **⚠ A SCREENSHOT CARRIES TERRAIN IDENTITY IF YOU KNOW YOUR OWN DEFS.** **⚠ CHECK THAT YOUR CONFIGURATION CAN EXPRESS THE DIFFERENCE BEFORE RUNNING THE EXPERIMENT.** **⚠ AND ON A BANDED MAP THE TIER IS PART OF THAT CONFIGURATION** (§30a): a gutter-crossing defect with reach 6 cannot exist at 300 and is unmissable at 190. **⚠ A CENSUS BEATS A MAGNITUDE.** **⚠ n=2 IS NOT A PATTERN, AND NEITHER IS n=4.** **⚠ TILE-INDEPENDENT WINS BEAT TILE-DEPENDENT ONES.** **⚠ Measure the ratio before optimising the half you assumed.** **⚠ A FIX CAN BE CHEAPER THAN THE BUG.** **⚠ WHEN A NEW RULE IS THE DUAL OF AN EXISTING ONE, SAY SO IN THE CODE.** **⚠ THE SYMPTOM SET IS ITSELF EVIDENCE** - but a symptom pair does not pick between two mechanisms that both explain it. **⚠ N MODS CAN BE FEWER THAN N PROBLEMS - COUNT THE CODEBASES, NOT THE MODS** (§30). Six requested mods collapsed to TWO patch families plus vanilla: three Dubwise mods ship byte-identical `UniversalPipeMapComp.RebuildPipeGrid`, and VCHE/VTE/Luciferium are thin content over VEF's `PipeSystem` - VCHE.dll contains FOUR classes and zero net code. **The mod list is a marketing artifact, not an architecture.** **⚠ A DEPENDENCY LIST NAMES THE REAL PATCH TARGET.** Reading About.xml and one def file beat reading three assemblies. **⚠ GATE AGAINST THE HOST MOD'S OWN UNLOCK, AND COPY ITS EXACT SHAPE - INCLUDING `MayRequire`.** DBH's pipes carry `
  • Plumbing
    • `: gated in lite mode, FREE otherwise. A hard gate would make our riser unbuildable for every normal DBH player. **A research gate can be conditional.** **⚠ A MOD CAN HAVE A RESEARCH SYSTEM THAT IS NOT `ResearchProjectDef`.** Rimatomics gates via `ResearchStepDef.Unlocks`, so `researchPrerequisites` is EMPTY on every Rimatomics pipe. **An empty research field means "look for another gate", not "no gate".** **⚠ AN ENUM IS A CAPABILITY LIST, NOT A CONTENT LIST.** `DubsBadHygiene.PipeType` declares four values; the defs use two. **Count usage in the DEFS.** **⚠ TWO CALL SITES OF ONE CONSTANT CAN NEED TWO DIFFERENT FIXES** (§30a). `ConnectMaxDist` is used by a nearest-wins SEARCH and by a candidate ENUMERATION. Filtering the enumeration is lossless because its caller takes every candidate; filtering the search is WRONG, because suppressing the winner silently disconnects things that had a legal second-best - there the search must be re-run scoped. **Before suppressing a result, ask whether the caller has best-of semantics.** **⚠ A LOSSY NORMALISER IS NOT A WAY TO READ A CHOICE.** **⚠ A CONSTRAINT SATISFIED BY EVERY EXAMPLE IS NOT NECESSARILY THE CONSTRAINT.** **⚠ A RULE ENFORCED BY GREPPING A SYNTAX ONLY CATCHES THAT SYNTAX.** **⚠ A DESIGN CHOICE RECORDED WITHOUT ITS COST WILL BE READ AS FREE.** **⚠ THE REAL CONFLICT IS USUALLY A REPLACEMENT, NOT A COLLISION.** **⚠ AND THE BUG AFTER THAT IS USUALLY A COLLABORATION.** **⚠ CHECK WHETHER IT IS ALREADY BUILT BEFORE BUILDING IT.** **⚠ A SHARED METHOD NAME IS A HYPOTHESIS, NOT A CONFLICT.** **⚠ Compat work is mostly deletion.** **⚠ Design for the foreign patch you have not met.** **⚠ Waste is often a sawtooth.** **⚠ The thing you rounded away may be load-bearing.** **⚠ Duplication is how an invariant dies.** **⚠ A comment is not an invariant.** **⚠ Steady-state fps hides burst cost.** **⚠ Timing that reads exactly 0.0 ms is an early return.** **⚠ In a foreign log, the loudest error is usually downstream.** **⚠ A finding scoped to vanilla does not transfer to mods.** **Patching.** Re-aim the shared parameter. Find the ONE virtual everything funnels through - and when there is none, **wrap the DATA instead of the reader**. Patch the PRODUCER, not the store. Own the widget. Never put a foreign type in a patch signature. **Suppress the callee, not the caller.** **Prefix state is released in a Finalizer.** **Repair a foreign method's output rather than reimplementing it.** **Never clamp a Def field to fix one map.** **Read the LIVE def field, never a baked copy.** **When a helper returns bool, use its return as the hand-off signal.** **⚠ NEW: prefer "detect, then redo" over "always redo"** - §30a's re-search runs only when vanilla's answer actually came from another band, so the normal path costs one integer divide. **Engine facts.** `holdSnowOrSand` defaults TRUE; `SnowGrid.CanHaveSnow` rejects on EITHER a `holdSnowOrSand=false` terrain OR a Full-fillage edifice. `SectionLayer_Snow` builds ONE nine-vertex-per-cell grid and rewrites only COLOURS. `TerrainDefGenerator_Stone` sets `edgeType = FadeRough` on `_Rough`, `_RoughHewn` AND `_Smooth`. A `TerrainHard` shader IGNORES vertex alpha; set `renderQueue` AFTER shader assignment. **Draw order between terrain materials is render QUEUE, NOT altitude or submission order.** A `dontRender` terrain makes vanilla's terrain layer emit only a ShadowMask. `Banded` is FALSE for all of map generation. `SectionLayer` subclasses auto-discovered on EVERY map. FinalizeInit runs on a worker thread - generation latches must be `[ThreadStatic]`. Ore defs have no `naturalTerrain`. `CameraJumper.TryJump` and `MapDrawer.MapMeshDirty` return silently unless `ProgramState == Playing`. Humanlikes past `ZoomRootSize` 18 render from an atlas blit. **Gensteps run with live-map bookkeeping DEFERRED (~40x cheaper).** Harmony skips POSTFIXES when the original throws but always runs FINALIZERS; a prefix returning false skips the original but POSTFIXES STILL RUN. **`FogGrid` is a `NativeBitArray` in 1.6.** `WaterInfo.GetWaterMovement` indexes `x * map.Size.z + z`. TileMutatorDefs compete within a `categories` entry. `ThingDef.graphic` is baked at PostLoad; `graphicData.Graphic` is lazily rebuilt. `subGraphic.MatSingle` of a linked graphic is the WHOLE atlas sheet. Every tile in a linked atlas has its four corners rounded away. **Vanilla rock links with `MapEdge`, so off-map counts as LINKED.** `Building.SpawnSetup` registers with the edifice grid unconditionally. `Map.FinalizeInit` calls `MapComponentUtility.FinalizeInit` LAST. `Building_Door.DrawMovers` draws the graphic TWICE. **⚠ POWER/PIPE ENGINE FACTS (§30).** **`PowerNetMaker.ContiguousPowerBuildings` is PRIVATE; its flood fill is `GenAdj.CellsAdjacentCardinal`** - public entry is `NewPowerNetStartingFrom(Building)`. **`PowerConnectionMaker.ConnectMaxDist = 6`**, used by BOTH `BestTransmitterForConnector` and `PotentialConnectorsForTransmitter` via `ExpandedBy(6)`, with NO line-of-sight, room or region check. **`RegionLink` is invisible to every power and pipe system in the game.** **⚠ A `private const` IS INLINED INTO THE CALLER'S IL AND CANNOT BE READ BY REFLECTION** - `AccessTools.Field` finds nothing, so a value like `ConnectMaxDist` must be COPIED, with the drift risk written down beside it. **A plain HarmonyPatch on a C# iterator targets the STUB, so `__result` is the whole `IEnumerable` and can be wrapped - but the wrapper body runs LAZILY, outside your try/catch** (saved to lore). --- # 15-19.
